description: Анализ метрик синхронизации: avg, min, max, RMS по master и slave узлам

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(time,'$__interval'),
  n.hostname AS metric,
  avg(offset_ns) AS "Offset (ns)"
FROM timesync.phc2sys_metrics m
JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = m.node_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND n.hostname ~ '${node:pipe}' AND n.type = '${phc2sys_node_type}'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  n.hostname,
  n.type::text AS type,
  round(avg(abs(offset_ns))) AS "Avg",
  min(offset_ns) AS "Min",
  max(offset_ns) AS "Max",
  round(sqrt(avg(power(offset_ns::float8, 2)))) AS "RMS"
FROM timesync.phc2sys_metrics m
JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = m.node_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND n.hostname ~ '${node:pipe}'
GROUP BY n.hostname, n.type
ORDER BY n.type, n.hostname

-- Кривые нод
SELECT
    n.hostname              AS hostname,
    m.window_size::numeric  AS window_size,
    m.mtie_ns               AS ns
FROM timesync.phc2sys_quality_metrics m
JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = m.node_id
WHERE (m.node_id, m.time) IN (
SELECT node_id, MAX(time)
FROM timesync.phc2sys_quality_metrics
GROUP BY node_id
)
UNION ALL
-- Маски
SELECT
unnest(ARRAY[
'Class C (200ns)',
'Class D (100ns)'
    ])                      AS hostname,

unnest(ARRAY[200, 100])   AS ns
FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT window_size
FROM timesync.phc2sys_quality_metrics

ORDER BY hostname, window_size
